h: Seeing the Joy of Redemption Within Mourning

p: ט׳ בְּאָב שֶׁחָל לִהְיוֹת בְּשַׁבָּת וְכוּלֵּי
"Tisha B'Av that falls on Shabbos, etc.,
he may set upon his table
even a meal like that of Shlomo in his time."
We need to understand why they went so far,
when it would have sufficed to say
"he eats and drinks all he needs";
that Rebbi read Kinos on this Shabbos,
And one may say about this,
עַל פִּי אָמְרָם זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (שָׁם ל, ב)
And certainly the meaning is not
the building of the Beis HaMikdash in his lifetime,
that he will merit the resurrection of the dead
and see the building of the Beis HaMikdash;
all Yisrael will merit the World to Come,
they shall inherit the land forever";
that he merits to see, while still
he feels the illumination of the joy.
And this is like the matter mentioned in the Midrash
at the time of the Churban,
and immediately he said to him
that Mashiach had already been born;
through the lowing of the ox,
and this is the matter of "cunning in augury,"
that is, through the chirping of birds.
And all the more so man,
if the generation is worthy of it.
And about this they said there in the Midrash:
"Why must we learn from the Arab?
הֲלֹא מִקְרָא מָלֵא הוּא (יְשַׁעְיָה י, לד)
Is it not an explicit verse (Yeshayahu 10:34):
'And the Levanon shall fall by a mighty one'
'And a shoot shall come forth from the stem of Yishai.'"
Now the matter of the Churban
is said in the future tense,
while the salvation is said in the past tense:
when there were revealed to him
the future events of the Churban,
immediately sensed and saw the salvation,
וְהִנֵּה אָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (בְּרָכוֹת לג, א)
Now our Sages, of blessed memory, said (Berachos 33a):
it is as if the Beis HaMikdash was built in his days:
and 'de'ah' is placed between two Names";
that is, between two holy Names,
which is the aspect of the union
of HaKadosh Baruch Hu and His Shechinah.
is the aspect of Knesses Yisrael:
that is, what a Jewish soul
faith in His providence, may He be blessed,
even though it is hidden and concealed from him,
this is called the aspect of Shechinah.
that there shine upon him from above
the illumination of His providence, may He be blessed,
And this is the matter of the union
of HaKadosh Baruch Hu and His Shechinah,
"He is truth and She is faith."
in the time of the Mikdash;
עַל יְדֵי חִיבּוּר הַמּוֹחַ עִם הַלֵּב
through the joining of the mind with the heart:
what one understands with his intellect
should be bound to the will in the heart.
And this is the union and joining
and that too is the union
of HaKadosh Baruch Hu and His Shechinah.
וְהִנֵּה עַל יְדֵי קְדוּשַּׁת יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת
Now through the holiness of the day of Shabbos
from what flows from the illumination above,
"For it is a sign between Me and you,
to know that I am Hashem who sanctifies you."
Therefore immediately at the departure of Shabbos
we begin the first weekday blessing:
the aspect of Daas shone in us,
and now it is hidden from us;
on the day of Shabbos itself,
immediately, in the present, her joy.
And for this reason Chazal termed it
"like the meal of Shlomo in his time":
for then "the moon was in its fullness,"
for then there was the completeness of the union
of HaKadosh Baruch Hu and His Shechinah.
And that is the meal of Shlomo,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר שָׁם (מְלָכִים א ד, כ)
like the sand that is by the sea,
And it is known that every eating and drinking
the verse speaks of words of Torah;
for this is the essential joy of the heart:
in the shining forth of holiness.
And for this there is the ability
to attain a semblance of this
when it falls on Tisha B'Av:
to merit to see her joy,
